The best place to find AI Upscaling models

OpenModelDB is a community driven database of AI Upscaling models. We aim to provide a better way to find and compare models than existing sources.

Compact
2x
90s Sonic 2x (Small)
by pokepress
Model designed for upscaling footage from Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog and Sonic SatAm (sorry Sonic Underground fans). These shows (produced by separate contractors/production companies) aired from 1993-1994. While they do consist of cel-based animation, some segments use panning to achieve > 24fps, so you'll probably want to use QTGMC to deinterlace if you're looking for maximum quality.
